remainingFindings.summary: bulkSetChannelPolicies accepts duplicate changes for the same channel and can append duplicate active routing/delivery policy rows in one all-or-nothing request.
evidence: packages/convex/confect/slack/channelPolicy.ts:197-281 iterates request.changes without rejecting duplicate channelKey values; each duplicate computes nextEpoch from request.existingRoutingPolicies/request.existingDeliveryPolicies only, not from policies already planned in the same request.

packages/convex/confect/slack/channelPolicies.impl.ts:121-144 deactivates active policies and inserts every planned routing/delivery row, so two changes for one channel in one request can both be inserted active with the same next epoch/generation.

packages/convex/test/channel-policies.test.ts has duplicate target coverage but no duplicate channelKey request coverage, so the all-or-nothing immutable epoch/generation contract is not pinned for this case.
remainingFindings.impact: A malformed or replayed client request can create multiple active policy rows for the same channel with the same epoch/generation, breaking active-pointer uniqueness, lifecycle history integrity, and stale revision fencing for channel policy changes.
remainingFindings.requiredFix: Reject duplicate channelKey entries in one bulk policy request with a typed PolicyInvalid (or equivalent declared typed error) before planning writes, and add focused backend coverage proving no duplicate active policy rows can be planned or inserted.
